description: This file defines types, functions, and API calls for browser automation actions such as navigation, clicking, typing, file choosing, downloads, screenshots, and dialogs in a web automation framework.

methods.name: postDownloadRequest
methods.description: Performs a POST request to initiate a download or wait for a download, returning the download result.

methods.name: browserNavigate
methods.description: Navigates the browser to a specified URL with optional target and profile.

methods.name: browserArmDialog
methods.description: Automates dialog acceptance or rejection with optional prompt text.

methods.name: browserArmFileChooser
methods.description: Automates file chooser dialog with specified file paths and optional references.

methods.name: browserWaitForDownload
methods.description: Waits for a download to complete, optionally for a specific file path.

methods.name: browserDownload
methods.description: Initiates a file download with specified reference and path.

methods.name: browserAct
methods.description: Performs a generic browser action request such as click, type, or scroll.

methods.name: browserScreenshotAction
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the current page or element, with options for full page and image type.
